goal: A controlled source reproduces an ordinary field event through Vixen's normal product behavior.
previousEvidenceScope: The button test proved live BLE transport and components of a separate harness pipeline. It did not prove normal field event processing or warning delivery.
requiredPath: Controlled source and real detector adapters emit the same canonical observation schema.
Source provenance/quarantine affects storage and admission only, not matching, model selection, analysis or presentation.
Normal preservation, triage and signature processing receive the observations.
Normal model availability and qualification behavior applies; no direct development-provider bypass.
The event, progress, explanation and warning appear through ordinary Events/Ops/notification surfaces.
The operator starts the source with its button; no app instrumentation, UI automation or injected phone-side answers during the run.
Preserved source and phone records verify timing, identity, sequence completeness and the actual result.
knownGaps: HarnessProtocol 0xE0 currently routes to LiveHarness rather than the ordinary event processing path.
LiveHarness uses provider.generate directly after checking that AiCoordinator would reject the model.
Ordinary AiCoordinator rejects the currently cached unqualified model.
The normal field protocol has no defined native Wi-Fi/BLE-outage or drone-signature observation at present.
The ordinary event list and DetectionAlerts do not receive the harness classification.
immediateChange: Remove the harness-only modal and LIVE HUNTER TEST control. Retain all earlier evidence and mark it as component-level verification.
passCriteria: No harness-specific presentation or alternate analysis branch.
Both the expected field result and unavailable/error states are shown honestly through the normal product workflow.
Controlled-source success is repeatable and supported by retained source/phone evidence.
modelFixStatus: SIG-001 remains open. A computed finding and schema constraint are containment, not general model qualification.
